_description: Block edits to sensitive files (env, credentials, secrets, production configs)
_usage: Merge into .claude/settings.json - exit code 2 blocks the tool
_requires: python3 (falls back to allow with warning if unavailable)

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); patterns=[r'\.env$',r'\.env\.',r'\.env/',r'credentials/',r'secrets/',r'api-keys\.',r'/production\.',r'/prod\.',r'\.git/']; match=any(re.search(pat,p) for pat in patterns); sys.exit(2) if match else sys.exit(0)" || (echo 'Warning: python3 unavailable, protected-files check skipped' >&2; exit 0)
